sloka: तमापतन्तं सङ्क्रुद्धं राक्षसानां भयावहम् ।ददर्शाकम्पनो वीरश्चुक्रोध च ननाद च ।। ६.५६.२५ ।।।।
transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ saṅkruddhaṁ rākṣasānāṁ bhayāvaham ।dadarśākampano vīraścukrodha ca nanāda ca ।। 6.56.25 ।।।।

translations.english: The heroic Akampana saw Hanuman coming towards him very angry. Fearing Hanuman, the Rakshasas ran roaring in fear.
